text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailtonSilva, Ailton) ∧ Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ LoanTo(ailtonSilva, Braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(Nautico) ∧ Club(Braga) ∧ Club(Fluminense) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (PlaysFor(x, Nautico) ∧ Brazillian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
